description_en: Update the data tables associated with your workspace by syncing the latest tables from a remote virtual data source and associating them with the specified workspace
description_zh: 更新当前业务空间所关联的数据表，从远程数据源（虚拟数据源）同步最近的表并关联到您所指定的业务空间
name: SyncRemoteTables

parameters.help_en: ID of the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace used for this request
parameters.help_zh: 当前请求所使用的阿里云百炼业务空间id
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
List of table names to keep and add columns for during association.

Keep and add: For tables marked as Keep and Add, the system retains information about already-associated columns and adds information about unassociated columns
parameters.help_zh:
关联数据表时，需要执行"保留并新增"操作的数据表名称列表。

保留并新增：对于选择“保留并新增"的表，析言将保留已关联列的信息，同时补充未关联列的信息
parameters.name: keep_table_names

parameters.help_en:
List of table names to keep and skip column updates for during association.

Keep and skip: For tables marked as Keep and Skip, the system retains all information about already-associated columns and does not add any information about unassociated columns
parameters.help_zh:
关联数据表时，需要"保留并跳过"的数据表名称列表。

保留并跳过：对于选择"保留并跳过"的表，析言将保留所有已关联列的信息，同时不补充任何未关联列的信息
parameters.name: no_modified_table_names

parameters.help_en: Whether to pull sample data when associating tables
parameters.help_zh: 关联数据表时是否拉取数据样例
parameters.name: pull_samples

parameters.help_en: List of names of tables to associate
parameters.help_zh: 需要关联的数据表的名称列表
parameters.name: table_names

requestId.description_en: Unique ID for the request. Use this ID to troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求id，每次请求都是唯一值，便于后续排查问题

success.description_en: True if the call succeeds. False if it fails
success.description_zh: true 接口调用成功，false 接口调用失败
